{{Conjecture|legends}}
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] codenamed [[Flitter (planet)|Flitter]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered Flitter's existence after capturing an [[Support Services/Legends|Alliance Support Services]] space transport en route to the planet and coercing its '''pilot''' to talk under interrogation.
